name: Simple mean, opponent-adjusted
description: Unweighted mean points for/allowed per team, adjusted for the average quality of opponents already faced.

G1 data integrity.note: Inputs are official NFL.com pages; each prediction uses only games played before the forecast week (no look-ahead).

G2 out-of-sample.note: Walk-forward evaluation over weeks 3-10; no random row splits.

G4 significance.note: 95% Bonferroni-adjusted bootstrap CI for spread-MAE improvement: [-0.226, 1.882].

G5 stability.note: Improvement positive in 62% of evaluated weeks (minimum 60%).

G6 calibration.note: Largest gap between predicted and observed cover rate: 0.076 (tolerance 0.12).

G7 not the benchmark.note: The league-constant benchmark is excluded from rewards by definition.
